root_idea.summary: An inward experience of fear or apprehension, expressed either as becoming afraid or as being fearful.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence shows the root across verbal and adjectival forms: experiencing fear, and being characterized by fear.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Merged as the feminine inflection of the adjective وَجِلٌ.
Merged as the masculine plural, substantivized adjectival form of وَجِلٌ.

senses.definition: To feel fear or apprehension; to become afraid.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of people or hearts experiencing fear. The Quran also attests the prohibitive construction لا تَوْجَلْ, “do not fear.”

senses.definition: Fearful or apprehensive; characterized by fear.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran attests the feminine form وَجِلَةٌ and the masculine plural وَجِلُونَ; the plural is used substantively for people who are afraid.

cautions: No Lane primary or Maqayis evidence was supplied for this root; the lexical coverage is therefore limited to the supplied Quran-focused evidence.
